scope: Live UI review at deployed commit 4425ccf; desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844. Review only, no application or forecast implementation.
value_proposition: Current administration power dynamics and 2028 nomination assessment in a single pane; daily briefings are inputs and supporting evidence.
findings: Primary overview foregrounds archive counts and chronology, not current power assessment.
Latest nominee assessment selects a technical migration snapshot.
Generic field rendering exposes internal identifiers and produces excessive page length.
Graph dominates faction landing page without explaining authority or leverage.
Mobile header about 224px; nomination section starts about 2206px below page top.
recommendations: Maintained current-assessment layer with explicit evidence and research freshness.
Integrated administration and nomination panels as primary dashboard.
Four task-based navigation destinations and contextual evidence access.
Purpose-built profiles, human-readable relationship labels and secondary graph/history views.
Compact responsive shell, stronger typography hierarchy and fewer equally weighted bordered containers.
